page_title: HAV 1-4 TOU | Le Havre v Toulouse 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
90+5' The whistle blows and Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is booked for an infringement.
90+5' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90+4' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' 55:45 – the ratio of ball possession.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
86' Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
85' The substitution has been made. Ilyes Housni (Le Havre) has replaced Josue Casimir.
83' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Vincent Sierro and he is replaced by Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) replaces Gabriel Suazo.

82' A short pass finds Aron Donnum (Toulouse). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
78' 1 - 4 Frank Magri (Toulouse) receives a precise pass inside the box from Aron Donnum and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 1:4.
75' Here's the change. Fode Ballo-Toure leaves the pitch and Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
74' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sees a yellow card from Francois Letexier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
72' Total attempts – 7:6.
70' Zakaria Aboukhlal goes off the pitch and Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) comes on.
67' The game is interrupted now, Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) replacing Yassine Kechta.
65' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Antoine Joujou will be replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
65' The game has come to an end for Ahmed Hassan. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).

63' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Aron Donnum (Toulouse). Gabriel Suazo plays a fantastic through ball and finds Aron Donnum (Toulouse), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 1:3.
63' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Djibril Sidibe is replaced by Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse).
63' Here comes a substitution. Shavy Babicka is given a rest as he is replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
59' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) has to leave the pitch!
59' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francois Letexier ignores the protests.
59' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Francois Letexier will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
56' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Mathieu Gorgelin no chance!
55' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
55' Referee Francois Letexier is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Toulouse!
54' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Toulouse as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
54' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) jumps into a tackle and Francois Letexier signals a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Toulouse.
51' 1 - 1 Issa Soumare (Le Havre) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the roof of the net. Excellent finish.
50' A clever short pass gives Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
48' What a beautiful long-range strike by Josue Casimir (Le Havre). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
46' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
46' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Now Toulouse have a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Joujou (Le Havre). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

45+7' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Le Havre.
45+5' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+4' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.

45+3' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Kjetil Haug anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
45+3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
42' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for an infringement.
40' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

37' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom left corner, but Mathieu Gorgelin pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
35' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Toulouse.
32' 57:43 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
30' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Le Havre players are visibly unhappy with the call.

30' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Francois Letexier interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
29' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
28' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
26' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Francois Letexier signals a set piece.
25' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' Celebrations are cut short for Toulouse as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
21' Wait! Referee Francois Letexier has indicated he is going to review the Toulouse goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
19' Vincent Sierro takes over corner duties and expertly finds Shavy Babicka (Toulouse), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 0:2.
19' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is about to take a corner kick.
19' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
16' Frank Magri (Toulouse) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
12' The foul by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) was seen by Francois Letexier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' 0 - 1 GOOOOOAL! Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 0:1.
7' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
2' The game is interrupted. Aron Donnum (Toulouse) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
